note: morph segment lookup off by one at a key frame blends into the previous key
anchor: if frame < Double(keys[mid].frame) { hi = mid } else { lo = mid + 1 }
replacement: if frame <= Double(keys[mid].frame) { hi = mid } else { lo = mid + 1 }

note: morph handles not lerped keep the left key's handles
anchor: out.append(.cubic(control1: lerp(ha.0, hb.0), control2: lerp(ha.1, hb.1), to: lerp(pa, pb)))
